# Contributing

- **Bugs and ideas:** open an issue with the form; attach the logs it asks for.
- **Code:** read [`docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`](../docs/DEVELOPMENT.md) first (build, tests, what CI runs). Keep the Release build at
  0 warnings. Small, focused pull requests against `master` please.
- **License:** by contributing you agree your change is released under the
  [PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0](../LICENSE.md), like the rest of the project.
